findings.claim: The new code will not compile because it calls `error.context(...)` without importing the `anyhow::Context` trait.
findings.evidence: The hunk adds `Err(error) => Err(error.context("UAR sidecar failed during startup")),` but the imports only add `use std::{net::SocketAddr, pin::Pin};` and do not bring `anyhow::Context` into scope.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `use anyhow::Context as _;` or replace the call with an explicit `anyhow!(...)` wrapping that does not require the trait.
